title: skillpack pack manifest (skillpack.pack.json)
description: Describes a skill pack. Lives at the pack root as skillpack.pack.json.

$schema.description: Schema URL. Its /v<N>/ folder sets the manifest format version; a manifest without $schema is read as v1.

name.description: The pack's scope: prefixes every installed skill and agent (<name>-<skill>). Lowercase letters and digits separated by single - or _, at most 24 characters. Skills and agents are always installed in kebab case (- only).

description.description: One-line summary shown by add, list and check.

cli.description: Semver range of skillpack CLI versions this pack works with. The CLI fails if its version is outside the range.

harnesses.description: Harnesses this pack supports. If set, only these are offered, and -a with another harness fails. If left out, all harnesses the CLI supports are offered.
